instruction: In LedgerDesk, generate Overdue invoices as of 2026-10-15. Include issued invoices with an outstanding balance and a due date strictly before that date, including partially paid invoices. Include customer, invoice number, balance, due date and days overdue. Sort by due date, then invoice number, ascending. Export as CSV.
environment: Linux X11 in Docker; 1200x900; no host mounts; desktop network internal
model_text: Generated the Overdue invoices report as of 2026-10-15 and exported 7 rows to `overdue-invoices.csv`.
